framework_library.description: An independently authored enterprise AI control library covering organizational AI governance, workforce use, AI systems, models, platforms, agents, data, operations, and third parties. Each control includes structured, machine-readable applicability metadata. The metadata expresses control authority; consuming decision services evaluate submitted facts. Controls do not require an external-framework mapping to be valid.
limitations: Does not establish legal compliance, certification, or standards conformity.
Requires organization-specific tailoring, ownership, testing, and approval.
Does not contain a risk-tier selection or recommendation engine.
framework_library.name: Independent AI Control Library
